title: Silver Crucible
description: The first 3 card rewards you see are Upgraded. The first Treasure Chest you open is empty.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic has two effects that work together: (1) Automatically upgrades the first 3 card rewards encountered, (2) Makes the first treasure chest empty once the 3 upgrades are used and at least one treasure room has been entered. The relic is disabled once both conditions are met. Only available in single-player runs.
